description: This PHP class defines validation rules for checking the uniqueness of entity property options within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configurations for trimming input, ignoring certain values, matching specific values, and ignoring entities by ID.

classes.name: EntityUniquePropertyOption
classes.description: A class that encapsulates rules for validating the uniqueness of entity property options, including trimming behavior, ignore values, and match values.

methods.name: setTrim
methods.description: Sets whether trimming should be performed on input values.

methods.name: getTrimFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the closure used to trim input values.

methods.name: hasIgnoreValues
methods.description: Checks if ignore values are set.

methods.name: setIgnoreValues
methods.description: Sets the values to be ignored during validation.

methods.name: setIgnoreId
methods.description: Sets an ID to be ignored during validation, adding it to ignore values.

methods.name: setMatchValues
methods.description: Sets specific match values for validation.

methods.name: hasMatchValues
methods.description: Checks if match values are set.
